verdict.rationale: The evidence covers mobile apps (iOS App Store, Google Play), a Chrome extension with toolbar queries and current-page context, a CLI, and MCP servers. None of it documents an official desktop app, OS-level keyboard shortcuts, or screen access. The Chrome extension's page awareness is a browser-scoped adjacent feature, not a desktop app reading what is on screen, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen
